caption: The drawing features a circular composition centered on a mostly blank, off-white background. Within the circle, the upper section depicts a landscape scene with three yellow houses, each with a red or orange roof and blue windows, surrounded by green trees and shrubbery. The houses are arranged side by side, with two larger trees positioned behind the buildings. The top edge of the circle is bordered by a decorative, wavy golden-yellow band. Below the houses, the lower section of the circle is filled with horizontal stripes in various colors, including green, black, white, and red. Further down, the bottom part of the circular composition contains a red area patterned with a repeating design of crescent-shaped motifs in blue, green, and yellow. The rest of the page is left unembellished, except for small, neat red text in the bottom right corner.
title: Beaded Purse
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
